sources.title: ai-hub-models/src/qai_hub_models/models/jais_6p7b_chat at main ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: The model is based on transformer-based decoder-only (GPT-3) architecture and uses SwiGLU non-linearity. It implements ALiBi position embeddings, enabling the model to extrapolate to long sequence lengths, providing improved context handling and model precision. The JAIS family of models is a comprehensive series of bilingual English-Arabic LLMs.

sources.title: model.aibase.com
sources.snippet: Jais models (`jais - family - *`) are *trained from scratch*, incorporating the SwiGLU non - linear activation function and ALiBi position encoding. These architectural enhancements allow the models to extrapolate at long sequence lengths, leading to improved context handling and precision.
